---
name: test-gap-analysis
description: Identify and prioritise missing behaviour tests across functional and non-functional risks.
---
# Test-gap analysis

Map requirements and risks to existing tests. Check happy paths, invalid input, boundaries, state transitions, dates/time zones, error paths, audit effects, persistence, concurrency, accessibility, and security hygiene. Prioritise by likelihood, impact, and uncertainty—not line count. Recommend test level and a minimal scenario. State expected-result assumptions and SME questions. Avoid duplicate tests and do not claim a gap is solved until evidence is run.
